answer: Quartz-Weighted Pairing Ledger: each identity must be co-signed by two existing identities that each spend one quill credit, an exhaustible allowance earned only through prior verified trades. Co-signers lose credits permanently if the new identity is later flagged, and their own allowance shrinks. Attackers must therefore run and maintain many independent credit-earning histories, one per fake identity, while every recruit cannibalizes the harbor of credits held by real participants.
